tool.name: resolve_obsidian_link
tool.description: Resolve an Obsidian link from its containing note using the existing resolver.

link.meaning: Raw Obsidian link text to resolve.

context_path.meaning: Path to the note containing the link.

vault_root.meaning: Optional allowed vault root containing the context path.

with_emplacement.meaning: Whether to include structured emplacement details.

status.meaning: Resolution outcome: resolved, unresolved, sub_target_not_found, ambiguous, or error.

target_path.meaning: Resolved target path, vault-relative with forward slashes.

target_range.meaning: Canonical target interval for heading, block, or structured-block targets.

is_embed.meaning: Whether the link is an embed; informational and does not change resolution.

display_text.meaning: Display text from the link; informational only.

candidates.meaning: Ambiguous candidate paths, sorted ordinally by vault-relative path.

reason.meaning: Actionable reason for a non-resolved outcome.

emplacement.meaning: Requested structured emplacement for a target inside a note.

outcomes.sub_target_not_found: The note resolved but its requested heading or block did not.
outcomes.ambiguous: More than one target matches the link.
outcomes.error: The resolver encountered an error; this remains a resolver result, not an MCP protocol error.
